summary: Preserve subscription collection evidence even when decoding leaves no usable account, while repairing slot-incompatible entries.

patterns: Retain the real locked auth-store mutation and strict credential decoder.
constraints: Both rejected-provider APIs must preserve every byte and return no change for subscription arrays, including all-invalid, empty, and legacy-only arrays.
An object in a subscription slot and an array in a metered slot must remain repairable.
Repair must mint replacement lineages without mutating input credentials or unrelated entries.
Receipts must contain the exact rejected entry and the exact written entry.
Use dummy credentials only. Do not access an installed account or service.
Change only src/infra/auth/auth-store-mutations.ts. Do not change tests, dependencies, or the runtime.
